strongest_angle: Examine the court petition filed in New York following the closed arbitration where former nanny Ericka Genaro's eight claims against Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde were dismissed entirely, alongside a $1.27 million award.

key_facts.fact: Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde's former nanny Ericka Genaro lost all eight of her claims in an arbitration battle.
Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde filed a petition in New York asking a judge to formally confirm portions of the arbitration ruling.
An arbitrator awarded Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde more than $1.27 million in damages, legal fees, and other costs.
Ericka Genaro originally filed a lawsuit in Los Angeles Superior Court alleging wrongful termination against Jason Sudeikis and Olivia Wilde in 2022.
